title: Considered purchase: a composition, usage or care story
when: The buyer reads before buying: composition, how to use, results.

steps.note: Its typography is that of `pdp-quiet-title-firm-price`, which keeps name and price on the first phone screen. Then `pdp-advantages-policies`: delivery, returns, payment, split payment only with Split connected, no try-on. Composition goes to the characteristics.

steps.when: the default story: eyebrow, a heading phrase, 16 px text at 560-640 px, a button to a real page, a 1:1 or 3:4 photo (`mediaRatio`; kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: Composition, usage or care as one chapter that leads on (a button or a link); 16 px text at a reading width.

variants.when: native fallback the merchant edits in the cabinet: a narrowed section, `###` heading, one paragraph of 300 characters or less ending with a link

steps.note: The store-wide subscription keeps the preset chosen on home: `section set` restyles it on every page. Only where it already sits on this page: `section add` makes an independent copy, not the shared one.

notes: On phones keep at most 3 blocks under the product card: the similar shelf, recently viewed and one chapter. Never copy home story grids under the product.

Before publishing, preview the product page: no «we do not deliver to this city» line (else `pdp-modules-prelaunch`), advantages only confirmed policies, no technical names in the chips. See references/product-page.md.
Per-product text (composition, usage, care) belongs in the product description and characteristics, not in section copies per product.

The chapter and the FAQ on the default product page show under every product of the store. In a catalog of a main product and its accessories (covers, gift wrap, refills) keep them neutral, true of everything the store sells, or put the main product's chapter and FAQ on a product variant that only the main products are assigned to: «what is inside the blanket» under a gift box misleads.
